content.question: How does the K-means algorithm work?
options: It merges the two closest clusters at each step until the desired number of clusters is reached.
It expands clusters around randomly selected points by recursively adding densely packed neighbours.
It iteratively assigns data points to the nearest centroid and updates each centroid based on the mean of the data points within the cluster.
It projects the data onto the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix.
content.answer: It iteratively assigns data points to the nearest centroid and updates each centroid based on the mean of the data points within the cluster.
